d:
BJP has fielded popular folk singer Maithili Thakur from the Alinagar Assembly seat, while the RJD has nominated Vinod Mishra against her.
This contest has caught attention not only because of Maithili’s huge fan base but also because of her statement proposing to rename Alinagar — a move that has sparked political and social debate.
In this exclusive Khabar Gaon ground report, we talk to the Muslim voters of Alinagar to understand:
• What do they think about Maithili Thakur’s candidature?
• How do they view Vinod Mishra from RJD?
